#### scripts
* `./scripts/Behavioral/master_stimuli.ipynb`: generate a master file for narrative stimuli.
* `./scripts/Behavioral/ABC_audio_ratings.ipynb`: report demogrpahic information and calculate the mean ratings by age group and across groups.


#### stimuli
* `./stimuli/audios`: the audio stimuli used in the fMRI experiment.
* `./stimuli/transcripts`: the transcripts of narratives.
* `./stimuli/master_stimuli.csv`: the master file of narrative stimuli, generated by `./scripts/Behavioral/master_stimuli.ipynb`.

#### segmentation
* `./derivatives/behavioral/segmentation`: segmentations of each narrative along with the corresponding reasons.

#### timestamps
* `./derivatives/behavioral/timestamps_word/*/align_RepApos.csv`: the word-level onset and offset timestamps generated by the forced aligner Gentle.
* `./derivatives/behavioral/timestamps_segment`: segment-level onset and offset timestamps.

#### ratings
* `./derivatives/behavioral/ratings/audio/ratings_audio_att2_comp2.csv`: the cleaned participant- and segment-level ratings. This was the data used for behavioral analysis. 
* `./derivatives/behavioral/ratings/audio/ratings_audio_att2_comp2_mean.csv`: the segment-level ratings averaged by age group and across age groups, generated by `./scripts/Behavioral/ABC_audio_ratings.ipynb`.
